jurisdictions.name: Kent County (Dover area, unincorporated)
jurisdictions.office: Kent County Department of Planning Services, Building Permits
notes: A permit is required for above-ground and in-ground pools, hot tubs and spas.
The county publishes a pool permit guide and a Pool Barrier Requirements Brochure on its building permit information page.
Kent County lists the 2018 International Residential Code with county amendments as adopted, and its page names no swimming pool code edition.
Fences over 7 feet need a permit except when enclosing a swimming pool area; zoning rules still apply.

jurisdictions.name: Milford
jurisdictions.office: City of Milford Building Inspections & Permitting
notes: The division handles building permits and inspections for residential work, and its page lists fee schedules and guidelines for pools among other project types.
Building permits, inspection scheduling and licences are handled through the city's Civic Access portal.
The page references the 2018 International Building Code, International Residential Code and International Swimming Pool and Spa Code.

jurisdictions.name: Newark
jurisdictions.office: City of Newark Code Enforcement Division
notes: The city's Forms and Applications page directs building permit applicants to its online self-service portal.
The page lists a downloadable Building Permit Application under the Code Enforcement Division; it has no pool-specific permit page.
